unknowns.why: randomAccount's balance generator is not in the bundle; only InsufficientBalance pins it (amount - 1 = 9). OK's observed checkSufficientBalance=true implies balance >= 10 there; TransferTxError is withheld, so its sufficiency is inferred, not observed. Hence the boolean from_account.balance_sufficient in the decision predicate.

unknowns.what: Whether NoAuthorization reaches createTransfer at all
unknowns.why: It is not listed among the 11 executions reaching createTransfer; middleware source shows an abort on empty header, so D0 predicts no handler entry, but no path is shown.

unknowns.what: Order of binding checks when both currency and amount are invalid
unknowns.why: D1 (currency) is modeled before D2 (amount), but NegativeAmount shows the currency validator runs even when amount fails; the validator library's field order/aggregation is outside the evidence. No test has both invalid.

unknowns.what: Race between balance check and TransferTx
unknowns.why: The guard reads the balance snapshot from GetAccount; TransferTx does not re-check balance (addMoney just adds). Concurrent transfers could still overdraw; tests use a mock store, so this is unobservable here.
Store is a gomock in every test; T1 is from source only and never executed.

unknowns.what: Whether 'calls' matching flattens nested callees (e.g. GetAccount, errorResponse inside validAccount)
unknowns.why: Decision branches list nested entities (GetAccount, errorResponse inside validAccount) in the order they appear in the rendered path; execution refs were restricted to top-level callees to avoid ambiguity.
